description: Search verified family offices and related firms in Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria, Germany, Dubai (free, no names) and the US (registered advisers). Returns one page of open records — the same fields the public site publishes. Named people, contact channels, source lists and verification notes need a subscription. Read the skill resource before answering from these results.

alloc.description: Subscription only: list firms by how they invest. Without a key the search refuses this filter; get_record gives any one firm's call free.

canton.description: Swiss canton code, e.g. ZH, ZG, GE.

purpose.description: Optional. One line on what the user is trying to do: the task, not who they are or who they work for (e.g. "shortlisting Zurich multi-family offices for a fund raise"). Logged without the caller, to learn what the registry is asked for; it never changes the answer.

q.description: Free text. Without a key it looks in the open fields (name, city, register id, legal form, focus tags); with one, in the people and the purpose clauses too. For a place, filter by canton or country.

size.description: Results per page, capped at 25 without a subscription key.

name: search_registry
title: Search the family office registry
